lots.what_it_is: Four framed works. The only item of note is a hand-coloured steel-engraved map of Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania in the Tallis/Rapkin style (decorative border and vignettes visible, c1849-1854), toned and foxed, framed and glazed. The others are an unsigned gatehouse watercolour or gouache, a small unsigned lake and mountain oil, and a sepia etching of a building facade.
